purpose: Fresh question-text-valid corpus-level retrieval evaluation without documentIds
selectionPolicy: Select only source questions that have never been executed in R1, R2, P3, or O2-P0.
Use only the original public-dataset question text; do not rewrite or generate questions.
Require the question text to contain enough named or distinctive context for corpus-level source localization.
Require Pure-text (Plain-text) evidence, a unique source-content SHA-256 in the 100-document corpus, and a unique PDF PageLabel to physical-page mapping for every Gold page.
Do not use any retrieval result when deciding inclusion or reserve status.
Take the first 80 eligible source rows in ascending sourceRowIndex order as the formal set; retain the final 3 as unused reserves.
